name: FastAPI CRUD Endpoint
prompt: Create a FastAPI endpoint for a 'Product' resource with CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete). Include: POST /products (create), GET /products (list), GET /products/{id} (get one), PUT /products/{id} (update), DELETE /products/{id} (delete). Use Pydantic models for validation. Return proper HTTP status codes. Include error handling for not-found cases.
